paper_title: Constraining the photon coupling of ultra-light dark-matter axion-like particles by polarization variations of parsec-scale jets in active galaxies
suggested_experiment_name: MOJAVE VLBA AGN jet polarization (Ivanov et al.)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis of Figure 6
notes: Paper constrains axion-photon coupling of ultralight DM ALPs via non-observation of periodic EVPA oscillations in MOJAVE VLBA polarization data of parsec-scale AGN jets. Abstract/conclusions state 95% CL limit g_agamma <~ 1e-12 GeV^-1 for masses ~5e-23 to ~1.2e-21 eV; full limit curve in Figure 6 has structure (roughly 3e-13 to 1e-11 GeV^-1 range) but no table given, so a flat two-point bound at the quoted 1e-12 GeV^-1 level is emitted. The limit assumes DM density at the SOURCE (elliptical galaxy centers) of rho_DM = 20 GeV/cm^3 (kappa=1); limits scale as kappa^(1/2). dm_density_assumed left null since this is not a local-halo haloscope assumption. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 48)) | Vision: Main result is Figure 6 (95% CL upper limit on g_agamma vs ALP mass, kappa=1, thick red line).
